mechanism: Both drugs are hepatotoxic and meloxicam (NSAID) may increase gastrointestinal irritation risk; isotretinoin causes mucocutaneous dryness that may be exacerbated by NSAIDs, and both can affect renal function.
action: Monitor liver function tests and renal function regularly; consider alternative analgesia if possible; counsel patient on GI protection and increased risk of mucocutaneous adverse effects.
